in_marathi.name: Vijayan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vijayan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Vijayan is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Vijaya’, which means victory. The name is commonly used in Hindu culture, especially among the Tamil and Malayali communities. It is a powerful and evocative name, suggesting strength, courage, and triumph.
